relics.name: Samantha's Drawing
relics.effect: A scrap of paper still warm from childish hands.
relics.conditions: Your equipped weapons swap to random different weapons every round (maintaining PaP level and rarity).

steps.title: Find Chompy
steps.body: In a Tier I Cursed match, look for Chompy — a trash can that appears in each POI but is only active in one spot at a time. Melee it to open it up.

steps.title: Feed Chompy one weapon of every rarity
steps.body:
Feed weapons in this exact order:
  1. Common — Your starting Jäger 45
  2. Uncommon (green)
  3. Rare (blue)
  4. Epic (purple)
  5. Legendary (orange)
steps.tip: Uncommon and Rare weapons become unobtainable in later rounds — feed them to Chompy early before they disappear.

steps.title: Feed Chompy the Ray Gun on Round 40+
steps.body: On or after Round 40, feed Chompy the Ray Gun or Ray Gun Mark II. This triggers the portal.

steps.title: Start the trial
steps.body: The Relic Portal spawns near Yuri's Lab at Zarya Cosmodrome. Survive 5 waves of zombies and HVTs. Ammo Caches and Max Ammos are disabled for the entire trial.

relics.name: Power Switch
relics.conditions: Randomises your Lethal and Tactical equipment after each round.

steps.title: Reach Round 20+
steps.body: Start on any tier of Cursed Mode on Totenreich and reach Round 20

steps.title: Grab a Scoped Weapon
steps.body: Buy a Sniper from the wall or use the mystery box to get a scoped weapon.

steps.title: Locate the 4 Deer Skull Totems Outside the Map
steps.body:
You have to look at a total of 4 totems and remember how many Deer skulls are attached to each Totem.
  • Eidskallen Landing - Stand opposite Rampage Inducer near barbed wire. The altar sits on the shoreline to the southwest.
  • Core Foundry / Dry Dock - Stand in Dry Dock just before the door to War Factory, look up at the cliff to the west.
  • Tyr's Foot - Stand with your back to Tyr's Foot look northwest toward the mountain.
  • Burial Grounds - From Skallen Market, head northeast and look up at the cliff edge above the Burial Grounds.

steps.title: Throw Axe at Animal Pelts in Viking Hall
steps.body:
Whilst looking into the hall from vultures aid, you will see 4 pelts. Hit each one according to how many deer skulls was on each totem in each location.
  • Front Right - Tyr's Foot
  • Back Right - Burial Grounds
  • Front Left - Core Foundry
  • Back Left - Eidskallen Landing

guides.name: Ashes of the Damned Main Quest
guides.author: community
guides.description: The complete main easter egg quest line. Restore power, collect key items, free Klaus, craft the Necrofluid Gauntlet, and take down the colossal Veytharion.
guides.conditions: Complete all main quest objectives in a single match. Rewards calling card, camo, and lore unlocks.

steps.title: Turn On the Power and Unlock Pack-a-Punch
steps.body: In the Janus Towers Plaza starting area, enter the white building and melee the floor grate to find T.E.D.D.'s Head. Exit west, find the pickup truck outside, and place T.E.D.D.'s Head onto Ol' Tessie.
steps.tip: Pack-a-Punch travels with Ol' Tessie wherever she goes.

steps.title: Exit 115 Diner — Obtain the Abomination Carcass
steps.body: Drive southwest to Exit 115 and buy the doors to Reba's Diner (1,250 Essence). Stay inside until the Cook zombie spawns. Kill him for the Freezer Key, then unlock the freezer.
steps.warn: The Cook only spawns and drops the key while you're inside the diner.

steps.title: Upgrade Ol' Tessie with Abomination Beam
steps.body: Drive back to the Ashwood Garage, park Ol' Tessie inside, and interact with the crafting table. Three abomination heads on the front of the truck now shoot lasers (R1/RB).
